environment.description: Same application deployed on GKE cluster in namespace 'webapp-prod' with Istio 1.20 service mesh. Istio sidecar injection enabled (istio-injection=enabled label on namespace). An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at mesh level that enforces source principal validation. Specifically, a namespace-scoped AuthorizationPolicy in 'webapp-prod' with spec.action=DENY for requests where source.namespace is not in ['webapp-prod', 'istio-system'] AND a second mesh-wide PeerAuthentication policy in STRICT mTLS mode. External traffic entering through istio-ingressgateway is assigned principal 'cluster.local/ns/istio-system/sa/istio-ingressgateway-service-account'. The ingressgateway VirtualService routes to the app but the gateway spec only binds to hosts matching 'app.internal.corp.net'. Browser-originated CSRF requests from attacker domains would hit the mesh ingress but the Gateway resource host matching rejects requests with Host headers not matching 'app.internal.corp.net'. Additionally, the envoy sidecar on the workload pod enforces the AuthorizationPolicy which requires the request to carry a valid SPIFFE identity from an allowed namespace - direct pod-to-pod traffic from outside the mesh (which lacks mTLS client cert) is rejected at the transport layer by the PERMISSIVE->STRICT PeerAuthentication upgrade.
